name: comparafood
description: ComparaFood — compare o preço final do seu pedido entre plataformas de delivery antes de pedir.

scripts.dev: npm run db:ensure -w backend && concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.start: npm run db:ensure -w backend && npm run start -w backend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w backend && npm run typecheck -w frontend
